features.name: Choose orientation sensor
features.expected: Two dropdowns let the user pick the reading type (Absolute/Relative) and optimization goal (Precision/Power) used by the other scenarios. Defaults: Absolute + Precision.

features.name: Data Events
features.expected: Enable registers a ReadingChanged listener and streams rotation data; Disable unregisters it. Enable is only enabled when an orientation sensor is present.

features.name: Polling
features.expected: Enable starts a DispatcherTimer that polls GetCurrentReading at an interval and displays rotation data; Disable stops it. Enable only enabled when a sensor is present.

features.name: Calibration
features.expected: Radio buttons simulate the current sensor accuracy. Selecting 'Unreliable' invokes the calibration bar (a popup prompting the user to calibrate). This is not hardware-gated.
